page: Microsoft Azure E128nds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by dedicated x86_64 Intel processors managed under Microsoft Hyper-V. Designed for massive in-memory computing footprints, the instance provides 128 dedicated vCPUs paired with 1024 GB of RAM, maintaining a consistent ratio of 8 GB of system memory per vCPU core.

Storage configuration includes 7559 GB of bundled high-speed local NVMe SSD capacity alongside support for Premium Storage tiers. The combination of network-optimized architecture and dense fast local NVMe makes the instance suitable for scenarios that require large temporary scratch space, cache arrays, or high-throughput I/O. Hardware acceleration is absent, as the system includes zero GPUs.

From an operational and resource standpoint, the instance offers significant compute and memory density within a single node. The architecture balances extensive memory allocation with multi-terabyte NVMe storage, eliminating external volume bottlenecks for local processing while trading off the physical segmentation found in smaller VM sizes. Note that complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

Azure E128nds_v6 is best matched for enterprise database engines, in-memory analytical data stores, large-scale Redis deployments, extensive ETL pipelines, and high-concurrency memory-intensive enterprise workloads.
